records.literal_gloss: And said Samuel to all Israel, behold, I have listened to your voice in all that you said to me, and I have made king over you a king.

en.L: And Samuel said to all Israel, "Look, I have listened to your voice in everything that you said to me, and I have set a king over you.
en.B: Samuel said to all Israel, "I have listened to you and done everything you asked of me. I have set a king over you.
en.R: Then Samuel spoke to all the people of Israel. He said, "I have done what you asked. I listened to you, and I have given you a king to rule over you.

es.L: Y Samuel dijo a todo Israel: «{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, he escuchado {{plural_you:su voz|vuestra voz}} en todo lo que me {{plural_you:dijeron|dijisteis}}, y he puesto sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} un rey.
es.B: Samuel le dijo a todo Israel: «{{plural_you:Los|Os}} he escuchado y he hecho todo lo que me {{plural_you:pidieron|pedisteis}}. He puesto un rey sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Entonces Samuel le habló a todo el pueblo de Israel. Les dijo: «He hecho lo que me {{plural_you:pidieron|pedisteis}}. {{plural_you:Los|Os}} escuché, y {{plural_you:les|os}} he dado un rey para que {{plural_you:los|os}} gobierne.

fr.L: Et Samuel dit à tout Israël : « Voici, j’ai écouté votre voix dans tout ce que vous m’avez dit, et j’ai établi sur vous un roi.
fr.B: Samuel dit à tout Israël : « Je vous ai écoutés et j’ai fait tout ce que vous m’avez demandé. J’ai établi un roi sur vous.
fr.R: Ensuite, Samuel a parlé à tout le peuple d’Israël. Il a dit : « J’ai fait ce que vous m’avez demandé. Je vous ai écoutés, et je vous ai donné un roi pour régner sur vous.

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên nói với cả Y-sơ-ra-ên: "Kìa, tôi đã nghe theo tiếng anh em trong mọi điều anh em nói với tôi, và tôi đã lập một vua trên anh em.
vi.B: Sa-mu-ên nói với cả Y-sơ-ra-ên: "Tôi đã nghe theo anh em và làm mọi điều anh em xin. Tôi đã lập một vua cai trị anh em.
vi.R: Bấy giờ Sa-mu-ên nói với toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên: "Tôi đã làm điều anh em xin. Tôi đã nghe theo anh em, và tôi đã cho anh em một vua để cai trị anh em.

decisions.choice: I have listened to your voice: Samuel did what the people asked in 8:5
decisions.reason: The words take up Yahweh's command to Samuel, "Listen to the voice of the people in all that they say to you" (8:7, 8:22). Samuel opens his farewell by saying that he has done exactly what he was told: the people asked for a king, and they have one.

decisions.choice: Samuel speaks at Gilgal, after Saul is made king there
decisions.reason: The chapter follows straight on from 11:14-15, where all the people went to Gilgal, made Saul king before Yahweh and offered peace offerings. Samuel's speech is his farewell as Israel's leader, and it opens a long speech that runs, with the people's answers, to the end of the chapter.

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and closes at the end of verse 3
alternatives: one quotation from verse 1 to verse 25
decisions.reason: Samuel's first words run from verse 1 to verse 3; the people answer in verse 4, and the speech is taken up again in verse 5. Each part opens and closes its own quotation marks. Literal has "look" for the Hebrew pointing word; Balanced and Readable leave it out.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֞ה הִנֵּ֥ה הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ׀מִתְהַלֵּ֣ךְ לִפְנֵיכֶ֗ם וַאֲנִי֙ זָקַ֣נְתִּי וָשַׂ֔בְתִּי וּבָנַ֖י הִנָּ֣ם אִתְּכֶ֑ם וַאֲנִי֙ הִתְהַלַּ֣כְתִּי לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם מִנְּעֻרַ֖י עַד־הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And now behold, the king [is] walking before you, and I, I am old and gray, and my sons, behold, they [are] with you; and I, I have walked before you from my youth until this day.

en.L: And now, look, the king is walking before you, and I, I am old and gray, and my sons, look, they are with you; and I, I have walked before you from my youth until this day.
en.B: Now the king will lead you. As for me, I am old and gray, and my sons are here among you. I have led you from my youth until this day.
en.R: From now on the king will lead you. I am old now, and my hair is gray. My sons are here with you. I have been your leader ever since I was a young man.

es.L: Y ahora, {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, el rey anda delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}; y yo, yo soy viejo y canoso, y mis hijos, {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, están con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}; y yo, yo he andado delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} desde mi juventud hasta el día de hoy.
es.B: Ahora el rey {{plural_you:los|os}} guiará. Yo ya soy viejo y canoso, y mis hijos están aquí entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Yo {{plural_you:los|os}} he guiado desde mi juventud hasta el día de hoy.
es.R: De ahora en adelante el rey {{plural_you:los|os}} guiará. Yo ya soy viejo, y tengo el pelo blanco. Mis hijos están aquí con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. He sido {{plural_you:su líder|vuestro líder}} desde que era joven.

fr.L: Et maintenant, voici, le roi marche devant vous ; et moi, je suis vieux et j’ai les cheveux blancs, et mes fils, voici, ils sont avec vous ; et moi, j’ai marché devant vous depuis ma jeunesse jusqu’à ce jour.
fr.B: Désormais, c’est le roi qui marchera à votre tête. Quant à moi, je suis vieux, j’ai les cheveux blancs, et mes fils sont parmi vous. Je vous ai conduits depuis ma jeunesse jusqu’à aujourd’hui.
fr.R: À partir de maintenant, c’est le roi qui vous dirigera. Moi, je suis vieux maintenant, et j’ai les cheveux blancs. Mes fils sont ici avec vous. J’ai été votre chef depuis que je suis jeune.

vi.L: Và bây giờ, kìa, vua đang đi trước mặt anh em, còn tôi, tôi đã già và tóc bạc, và các con trai tôi, kìa, chúng đang ở với anh em; còn tôi, tôi đã đi trước mặt anh em từ thuở thiếu thời cho đến ngày nay.
vi.B: Bây giờ vua sẽ dẫn dắt anh em. Còn tôi, tôi đã già, tóc đã bạc, và các con trai tôi đang ở giữa anh em. Tôi đã dẫn dắt anh em từ thuở thiếu thời cho đến ngày nay.
vi.R: Từ nay vua sẽ dẫn dắt anh em. Tôi bây giờ đã già, tóc đã bạc. Các con trai tôi đang ở đây với anh em. Tôi đã lãnh đạo anh em từ khi tôi còn trẻ.

decisions.choice: walk before you: lead you and live openly in your sight
decisions.reason: To walk before a people is to go ahead of them as their leader, in full view of them. The same words are used of the king and of Samuel: the king is now taking over the role Samuel has had all his life.

decisions.choice: I am old and gray, and my sons are with you
alternatives: my sons are with you: they are no longer in office, but ordinary members of the people
decisions.reason: The elders had given Samuel's age and his sons' failures as their reason for asking for a king (8:1-5). Samuel mentions his sons without defending them: they are there among the people, and anyone may bring a charge against them. He then turns to his own record.

decisions.choice: will lead you; I have led you (Balanced); will lead you; I have been your leader (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the idiom "walk before". The Hebrew participle describes what is now under way, which English puts as "will lead you" from now on.

source.text: הִנְנִ֣י עֲנ֣וּ בִי֩ נֶ֨גֶד יְהוָ֜ה וְנֶ֣גֶד מְשִׁיח֗וֹ אֶת־שׁוֹר֩׀מִ֨י לָקַ֜חְתִּי וַחֲמ֧וֹר מִ֣י לָקַ֗חְתִּי וְאֶת־מִ֤י עָשַׁ֨קְתִּי֙ אֶת־מִ֣י רַצּ֔וֹתִי וּמִיַּד־מִי֙ לָקַ֣חְתִּי כֹ֔פֶר וְאַעְלִ֥ים עֵינַ֖י בּ֑וֹ וְאָשִׁ֖יב לָכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Behold me, testify against me before YHWH and before his anointed: [the] ox of whom have I taken, and [the] donkey of whom have I taken, and whom have I oppressed, whom have I crushed, and from [the] hand of whom have I taken a ransom, and I hid my eyes with it? And I will restore [it] to you.

en.L: Here I am; testify against me before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and before {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anointed: Whose ox have I taken, and whose donkey have I taken? Whom have I oppressed? Whom have I crushed? From whose hand have I taken a bribe to blind my eyes with it? And I will restore it to you."
en.B: Here I am. Bring your charges against me before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and before {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anointed. Whose ox did I take? Whose donkey? Whom did I cheat? Whom did I treat harshly? From whom did I take a bribe to make me look the other way? If I have, I will pay it back to you."
en.R: Here I am. Tell me now, in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and the king {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has anointed: Have I ever taken anyone's ox or donkey? Have I cheated anyone? Have I been cruel to anyone? Have I ever taken money from anyone to make me ignore what was wrong? If I have done any of these things, I will pay it back."

es.L: Aquí estoy; {{plural_you:testifiquen|testificad}} contra mí delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y delante de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ungido: ¿De quién he tomado el buey, y de quién he tomado el asno? ¿A quién he oprimido? ¿A quién he quebrantado? ¿De mano de quién he tomado soborno para cegar con él mis ojos? Y se lo devolveré».
es.B: Aquí estoy. {{plural_you:Presenten|Presentad}} {{plural_you:sus acusaciones|vuestras acusaciones}} contra mí delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y delante de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ungido. ¿A quién le quité un buey? ¿A quién un asno? ¿A quién estafé? ¿A quién traté con dureza? ¿De quién acepté soborno para hacerme de la vista gorda? Si lo hice, se lo devolveré».
es.R: Aquí estoy. {{plural_you:Díganme|Decidme}} ahora, delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y del rey que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha ungido: ¿Alguna vez le quité a alguien su buey o su burro? ¿He estafado a alguien? ¿He sido cruel con alguien? ¿Alguna vez acepté dinero de alguien para no ver lo que estaba mal? Si he hecho alguna de estas cosas, lo devolveré».

fr.L: Me voici ; témoignez contre moi devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et devant {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} oint : de qui ai-je pris le bœuf, et de qui ai-je pris l’âne ? Qui ai-je opprimé ? Qui ai-je écrasé ? De la main de qui ai-je pris une rançon pour m’en couvrir les yeux ? Et je vous le rendrai. »
fr.B: Me voici. Portez vos accusations contre moi devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et devant {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} oint. À qui ai-je pris son bœuf ? À qui son âne ? Qui ai-je exploité ? Qui ai-je maltraité ? De qui ai-je accepté un pot-de-vin pour fermer les yeux ? Si je l’ai fait, je vous le rendrai. »
fr.R: Me voici. Dites-le maintenant, devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et devant le roi qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a oint : Est-ce que j’ai déjà pris le bœuf ou l’âne de quelqu’un ? Est-ce que j’ai volé quelqu’un ? Est-ce que j’ai été cruel envers quelqu’un ? Est-ce que j’ai déjà accepté de l’argent de quelqu’un pour fermer les yeux sur le mal ? Si j’ai fait une de ces choses, je vous la rendrai. »

vi.L: Tôi đây; hãy làm chứng nghịch cùng tôi trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và trước mặt người được xức dầu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: Tôi đã lấy bò của ai, đã lấy lừa của ai? Tôi đã áp bức ai? Tôi đã chà đạp ai? Tôi đã nhận của hối lộ từ tay ai để bịt mắt mình lại? Tôi sẽ hoàn trả cho anh em."
vi.B: Tôi đây. Hãy tố cáo tôi trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và trước mặt vị vua được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xức dầu. Tôi đã lấy bò của ai? Lừa của ai? Tôi đã lừa gạt ai? Tôi đã đối xử khắc nghiệt với ai? Tôi đã nhận hối lộ của ai để làm ngơ? Nếu có, tôi sẽ hoàn trả cho anh em."
vi.R: Tôi đây. Bây giờ hãy nói trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và vị vua {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã xức dầu: Tôi có bao giờ lấy bò hay lừa của ai không? Tôi có lừa gạt ai không? Tôi có tàn nhẫn với ai không? Tôi có bao giờ nhận tiền của ai để làm ngơ điều sai trái không? Nếu tôi đã làm bất cứ điều nào trong những điều ấy, tôi sẽ hoàn trả."

decisions.choice: his anointed: the king Yahweh has set apart, here Saul
decisions.reason: The anointed one is the person on whom oil was poured to set him apart for his office (10:1). Hannah's song already speaks of Yahweh's anointed king (2:10). Samuel calls on Yahweh and on the newly anointed king together as the witnesses of his record.

decisions.choice: ox, donkey, bribe: the abuses of a ruler
decisions.reason: Samuel names what a corrupt leader takes from the people. His questions answer his own warning about what a king would take (8:11-17) and the bribes his sons took (8:3). Moses made the same claim, that he had not taken one donkey from the people (Numbers 16:15).

decisions.choice: ransom here means a bribe
decisions.reason: The word means a payment that buys someone off. In a judge's hand it is a bribe paid to make him let a guilty person go (Amos 5:12).

decisions.choice: to hide my eyes with it: to look away from wrong
decisions.reason: A bribe blinds a judge's eyes so that he does not see the guilt in front of him (Exodus 23:8; Deuteronomy 16:19).

decisions.choice: to blind my eyes with it
alternatives: or even a pair of sandals (Greek)
decisions.reason: The Greek translation reads "a bribe, or even a pair of sandals? Testify against me" in place of "to blind my eyes with it", which seems to come from a Hebrew text differing by a few letters. The Hebrew text is followed here; the sense of the question is the same, that Samuel took no payment of any kind.

decisions.choice: the king he has anointed
decisions.reason: Readable spells out who the anointed one is, as the terms for Samuel set out for "the LORD's anointed".

decisions.choice: If I have, I will pay it back
decisions.reason: The Hebrew ends with a short "and I will restore it to you"; Balanced and Readable state the condition it implies.

decisions.choice: "son oint" (Literal, Balanced); "le roi qu’il a oint" (Readable)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note settles for *mashiaḥ YHWH*: "oint" keeps the link with the anointing of 10:1, and Readable says plainly that the anointed one is the king, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "su ungido" (L, B); "el rey que él ha ungido" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note for *mashiaḥ YHWH* and 2:10: Literal and Balanced keep "ungido"; Readable says who is meant (m1).

decisions.choice: "người được xức dầu của Ngài" (L); "vị vua được Ngài xức dầu" (B); "vị vua CHÚA đã xức dầu" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note for *mashiaḥ YHWH*. Readable names the LORD again where the English Readable has "he", so the divine name span appears once more there.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ לֹ֥א עֲשַׁקְתָּ֖נוּ וְלֹ֣א רַצּוֹתָ֑נוּ וְלֹֽא־לָקַ֥חְתָּ מִיַּד־אִ֖ישׁ מְאֽוּמָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And they said, not you have oppressed us and not you have crushed us, and not you have taken from [the] hand of anyone anything.

en.L: And they said, "You have not oppressed us, and you have not crushed us, and you have not taken anything from [the] hand of anyone."
en.B: They answered, "You have not cheated us or treated us harshly, and you have not taken anything from anyone."
en.R: The people answered, "No. You have never cheated us or been cruel to us. You have never taken anything from anyone."

es.L: Y dijeron: «No nos has oprimido, ni nos has quebrantado, ni has tomado nada de mano de nadie».
es.B: Ellos respondieron: «No nos has estafado ni nos has tratado con dureza, ni le has quitado nada a nadie».
es.R: El pueblo respondió: «No. Nunca nos has estafado ni has sido cruel con nosotros. Nunca le has quitado nada a nadie».

fr.L: Et ils dirent : « Tu ne nous as pas opprimés, et tu ne nous as pas écrasés, et tu n’as rien pris de la main de personne. »
fr.B: Ils répondirent : « Tu ne nous as ni exploités ni maltraités, et tu n’as rien pris à personne. »
fr.R: Le peuple a répondu : « Non. Tu ne nous as jamais volés et tu n’as jamais été cruel envers nous. Tu n’as jamais rien pris à personne. »

vi.L: Họ nói: "Ông không áp bức chúng tôi, không chà đạp chúng tôi, và không lấy gì từ tay ai cả."
vi.B: Họ đáp: "Ông không lừa gạt chúng tôi, không đối xử khắc nghiệt với chúng tôi, và không lấy gì của ai cả."
vi.R: Dân chúng đáp: "Không. Ông chưa bao giờ lừa gạt hay tàn nhẫn với chúng tôi. Ông chưa bao giờ lấy gì của ai cả."

decisions.choice: the people repeat Samuel's own words
decisions.reason: The people answer with the same verbs Samuel used (verse 3) and add "from anyone" and "anything" to make their answer complete. Samuel's record as a leader is cleared in full.

decisions.choice: cheated, treated harshly (Balanced); cheated, been cruel (Readable)
decisions.reason: The first verb means to oppress by taking what belongs to another, by force or fraud; the second means to crush, to treat someone roughly. Balanced and Readable use everyday words for both, as in verse 3.

decisions.choice: The people answered, "No.
decisions.reason: Readable names the speakers and adds "No" to make the answer clear.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם עֵ֧ד יְהוָ֣ה בָּכֶ֗ם וְעֵ֤ד מְשִׁיחוֹ֙ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה כִּ֣י לֹ֧א מְצָאתֶ֛ם בְּיָדִ֖י מְא֑וּמָה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר עֵֽד׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And he said to them, witness [is] YHWH against you, and witness [is] his anointed this day, that not you have found in my hand anything; and [one] said, witness.

en.L: And he said to them, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is witness against you, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anointed is witness this day, that you have not found anything in my hand." And they said, "[He is] witness."
en.B: Samuel said to them, "Today {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is witness against you, and so is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anointed: you have found nothing in my hand." "He is witness," they said.
en.R: Samuel told them, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has heard you and is a witness against you, and so is the king {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has anointed. Today they have both heard you say that I have taken nothing from anyone." The people said, "Yes, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is witness."

es.L: Y les dijo: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es testigo contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ungido es testigo en este día, de que no {{plural_you:han hallado|habéis hallado}} nada en mi mano». Y dijeron: «[Él es] testigo».
es.B: Samuel les dijo: «Hoy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es testigo contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y también lo es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ungido: no {{plural_you:han encontrado|habéis encontrado}} nada en mi mano». «Él es testigo», dijeron.
es.R: Samuel les dijo: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:los|os}} ha oído y es testigo contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y también lo es el rey que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha ungido. Hoy los dos {{plural_you:los|os}} han oído decir que yo no le he quitado nada a nadie». El pueblo dijo: «Sí, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es testigo».

fr.L: Et il leur dit : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est témoin contre vous, et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} oint est témoin en ce jour, que vous n’avez rien trouvé dans ma main. » Et ils dirent : « [Il est] témoin. »
fr.B: Samuel leur dit : « Aujourd’hui, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est témoin contre vous, et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} oint aussi : vous n’avez rien trouvé dans mes mains. » « Il en est témoin », dirent-ils.
fr.R: Samuel leur a dit : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a entendus et il est témoin contre vous, ainsi que le roi qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a oint. Aujourd’hui, ils vous ont entendus dire tous les deux que je n’ai rien pris à personne. » Le peuple a dit : « Oui, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} en est témoin. »

vi.L: Người nói với họ: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm chứng nghịch cùng anh em, và người được xức dầu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm chứng hôm nay, rằng anh em không tìm thấy gì trong tay tôi." Họ nói: "[Ngài là] Đấng làm chứng."
vi.B: Sa-mu-ên nói với họ: "Hôm nay {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm chứng nghịch cùng anh em, và vị vua được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xức dầu cũng vậy: anh em không tìm thấy gì trong tay tôi." Họ đáp: "Ngài là Đấng làm chứng."
vi.R: Sa-mu-ên nói với họ: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã nghe anh em và làm chứng nghịch cùng anh em, vị vua {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã xức dầu cũng vậy. Hôm nay cả hai đều nghe anh em nói rằng tôi không lấy gì của ai cả." Dân chúng nói: "Vâng, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đấng làm chứng."

decisions.choice: witness against you: the people are now bound by what they have said
decisions.reason: Yahweh and the king are witnesses "against" the people: if the people later complain about Samuel, these witnesses will stand against their complaint. Samuel's record is settled before the king takes over.

decisions.choice: and they said (the sense of the singular verb)
alternatives: and he said: one man answered for the people
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is singular, "and he said": either the people answer as one, or one person speaks for them all. Some Hebrew manuscripts and the Greek and Syriac translations have the plural "they said". The meaning is the same either way: the people agree.

decisions.choice: found in my hand: found that I have taken
decisions.reason: What is "in my hand" is what I hold or have taken. The people have found that Samuel took nothing that was not his.

decisions.choice: [He is] witness
decisions.reason: The people answer with one word, "Witness". Literal supplies "he is"; Balanced writes it without brackets; Readable names Yahweh as the witness, since the reply takes up Samuel's first words.

decisions.choice: they have both heard you say that I have taken nothing from anyone
decisions.reason: Readable spells out what the witnesses are witnesses to.

source.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל אֶל־הָעָ֑ם יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאֶֽת־אַהֲרֹ֔ן וַאֲשֶׁ֧ר הֶעֱלָ֛ה אֶת־אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Samuel to the people, YHWH, who made Moses and Aaron, and who brought up your fathers from [the] land of Egypt.

en.L: And Samuel said to the people, "[It is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who made Moses and Aaron, and who brought your fathers up from the land of Egypt.
en.B: Samuel said to the people, "It is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who appointed Moses and Aaron and brought your {{gender:ancestors|fathers}} up from the land of Egypt.
en.R: Then Samuel said to the people, "It was {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who chose Moses and Aaron to be your leaders. He brought your {{gender:ancestors|fathers}} up out of Egypt.

es.L: Y Samuel dijo al pueblo: «[Es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} el que hizo a Moisés y a Aarón, y el que hizo subir a {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}} de la tierra de Egipto.
es.B: Samuel le dijo al pueblo: «Es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} quien designó a Moisés y a Aarón y sacó a {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} de la tierra de Egipto.
es.R: Luego Samuel le dijo al pueblo: «Fue {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} quien escogió a Moisés y a Aarón para que fueran {{plural_you:sus líderes|vuestros líderes}}. Él sacó a {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} de Egipto.

fr.L: Et Samuel dit au peuple : « [C’est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui a fait Moïse et Aaron, et qui a fait monter vos pères du pays d’Égypte.
fr.B: Samuel dit au peuple : « C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui a établi Moïse et Aaron, et qui a fait monter vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} du pays d’Égypte.
fr.R: Ensuite, Samuel a dit au peuple : « C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui a choisi Moïse et Aaron pour être vos chefs. C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui a fait sortir vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} d’Égypte.

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên nói với dân chúng: "[Chính] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đấng đã lập Môi-se và A-rôn, và là Đấng đã đem tổ phụ anh em lên khỏi đất Ai Cập.
vi.B: Sa-mu-ên nói với dân chúng: "Chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã lập Môi-se và A-rôn, và đã đem tổ tiên anh em lên khỏi đất Ai Cập.
vi.R: Rồi Sa-mu-ên nói với dân chúng: "Chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chọn Môi-se và A-rôn làm người lãnh đạo anh em. Ngài đã đem tổ tiên anh em ra khỏi Ai Cập.

decisions.choice: the Hebrew has "Yahweh, who made Moses and Aaron" with no verb
alternatives: Yahweh is witness, who appointed Moses and Aaron (Greek)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sentence names Yahweh and says what he has done, but has no main verb. The Greek translation adds "is witness", taking up verse 5: "Yahweh is witness, who made Moses and Aaron". The Hebrew text is followed here and read as a statement that it is Yahweh who did these things; verse 7 goes on to the case Samuel makes from them.

decisions.choice: made: appointed to their task
decisions.reason: The verb "make" is used here of putting people into an office, as it is of priests (1 Kings 12:31). Yahweh did not only send Moses and Aaron; he made them the leaders they were.

decisions.choice: It is (It was) the LORD who ...
decisions.reason: English needs a verb. Literal brackets "It is"; Balanced and Readable write it plainly. Readable says what "appointed" meant for Moses and Aaron: to lead the people.

decisions.choice: appointed (Balanced); chose ... to be your leaders (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of "made" here; Literal keeps the Hebrew word.

decisions.choice: vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}
decisions.reason: As the English: the default says "ancestors", men and women, with the traditional "pères" as the alternative; Literal keeps "vos pères", as the English Literal keeps "fathers".

decisions.choice: "{{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}}" (L); "{{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}}" (B, R), with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in English
decisions.reason: The English Balanced and Readable offer "ancestors" or "fathers". Spanish "antepasados" already includes women, and "padres" at Literal is the ordinary plural for parents and forebears, so Spanish needs no gender setting; the plural-you span carries the possessive.

decisions.choice: "tổ phụ" (L), "tổ tiên" (B, R) for "fathers", with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Tổ tiên" already means ancestors of both sexes, which is the English default; Literal keeps "tổ phụ", the word for forefathers, as the English Literal keeps "fathers". "Môi-se" and "A-rôn" are the forms of the Vietnamese New Testament.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה הִֽתְיַצְּב֛וּ וְאִשָּׁפְטָ֥ה אִתְּכֶ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֵ֚ת כָּל־צִדְק֣וֹת יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֥ה אִתְּכֶ֖ם וְאֶת־אֲבוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, present yourselves, and I will enter into judgment with you before YHWH [concerning] all [the] righteous acts of YHWH which he did with you and with your fathers.

en.L: And now, present yourselves, and let me enter into judgment with you before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [concerning] all the righteous acts of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did with you and with your fathers.
en.B: So now take your stand, and I will put the case to you before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, recounting all the righteous acts that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has done for you and for your {{gender:ancestors|fathers}}.
en.R: Now stand here in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I am going to argue my case with you. I will remind you of all the good and right things {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has done to save you and your {{gender:ancestors|fathers}}.

es.L: Y ahora, {{plural_you:preséntense|presentaos}}, y entraré en juicio con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [acerca de] todos los actos de justicia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hizo con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y con {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}}.
es.B: Así que ahora {{plural_you:preséntense|presentaos}}, y {{plural_you:les|os}} expondré mi causa delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, recordando todos los actos de justicia que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hecho por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y por {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}}.
es.R: Ahora {{plural_you:pónganse|poneos}} aquí delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Voy a presentar mi caso ante {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. {{plural_you:Les|Os}} recordaré todas las cosas buenas y justas que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hecho para {{plural_you:salvarlos|salvaros}} a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y a {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}}.

fr.L: Et maintenant, présentez-vous, et que j’entre en jugement avec vous devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [au sujet de] tous les actes justes {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a accomplis envers vous et envers vos pères.
fr.B: Maintenant donc, tenez-vous là, et je vais plaider avec vous devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, en rappelant tous les actes de justice que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a accomplis pour vous et pour vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}.
fr.R: Maintenant, restez là devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Je vais vous faire un procès. Je vais vous rappeler toutes les choses bonnes et justes que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a faites pour vous sauver, vous et vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}.

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, hãy đứng đó, để tôi tranh luận với anh em trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [về] mọi việc công chính của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho anh em và cho tổ phụ anh em.
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ hãy đứng đó, tôi sẽ trình bày lý lẽ với anh em trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, kể lại mọi việc công chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm cho anh em và cho tổ tiên anh em.
vi.R: Bây giờ hãy đứng đây trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Tôi sẽ trình bày lý lẽ với anh em. Tôi sẽ nhắc lại cho anh em mọi điều tốt lành và công chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm để giải cứu anh em và tổ tiên anh em.

decisions.choice: take your stand ... enter into judgment: Samuel speaks like a man making a case in court
decisions.reason: The people are to stand as at a hearing, and Samuel will argue a case with them before Yahweh as judge. The same picture of a lawsuit between Yahweh and his people is used by the prophets (Micah 6:1-5; Jeremiah 2:9).

decisions.choice: righteous acts: the deeds by which Yahweh rescued his people and kept faith with them
decisions.reason: The plural of the word for righteousness names Yahweh's saving deeds, the acts in which he did right by his people and set them free. The Song of Deborah uses the same phrase for the victories of Yahweh (Judges 5:11). Samuel's list follows in verses 8-11.

decisions.choice: recounting
decisions.reason: The Hebrew simply puts "all the righteous acts" after the verb as the matter of the case. Literal supplies [concerning]; Balanced adds "recounting" to show how the righteous acts belong to the case.

decisions.choice: the good and right things the LORD has done to save you
decisions.reason: Readable explains "righteous acts": what the LORD did to rescue the people, which showed that he was right and faithful.

source.text: כַּֽאֲשֶׁר־בָּ֥א יַעֲקֹ֖ב מִצְרָ֑יִם וַיִּזְעֲק֤וּ אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ אֶל־יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאֶֽת־אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַיּוֹצִ֤יאוּ אֶת־אֲבֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם וַיֹּשִׁב֖וּם בַּמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: When went Jacob [to] Egypt, and cried out your fathers to YHWH, and sent YHWH Moses and Aaron, and they brought out your fathers from Egypt, and they settled them in this place.

en.L: When Jacob went to Egypt, your fathers cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sent Moses and Aaron, and they brought your fathers out of Egypt and settled them in this place.
en.B: After Jacob went to Egypt, your {{gender:ancestors|fathers}} cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sent Moses and Aaron. They brought your {{gender:ancestors|fathers}} out of Egypt and settled them in this place.
en.R: Long ago Jacob and his family went down to Egypt. Later your {{gender:ancestors|fathers}} cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for help, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sent Moses and Aaron. They led your {{gender:ancestors|fathers}} out of Egypt and gave them a home in this land.

es.L: Cuando Jacob fue a Egipto, {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}} clamaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} envió a Moisés y a Aarón, y ellos sacaron a {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}} de Egipto y los hicieron habitar en este lugar.
es.B: Después de que Jacob fue a Egipto, {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} clamaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} envió a Moisés y a Aarón. Ellos sacaron a {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} de Egipto y los establecieron en este lugar.
es.R: Hace mucho tiempo, Jacob y su familia bajaron a Egipto. Más tarde {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} clamaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} pidiendo ayuda, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} envió a Moisés y a Aarón. Ellos sacaron a {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} de Egipto y les dieron un hogar en esta tierra.

fr.L: Quand Jacob vint en Égypte, vos pères crièrent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} envoya Moïse et Aaron, et ils firent sortir vos pères d’Égypte et les établirent en ce lieu.
fr.B: Après que Jacob fut allé en Égypte, vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} crièrent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} envoya Moïse et Aaron. Ceux-ci firent sortir vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} d’Égypte et les établirent dans ce pays.
fr.R: Il y a très longtemps, Jacob et sa famille sont descendus en Égypte. Plus tard, vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} ont appelé {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au secours, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a envoyé Moïse et Aaron. Ils ont fait sortir vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} d’Égypte et leur ont donné une demeure dans ce pays.

vi.L: Khi Gia-cốp đến Ai Cập, tổ phụ anh em kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sai Môi-se và A-rôn đến; họ đem tổ phụ anh em ra khỏi Ai Cập và cho họ định cư tại nơi này.
vi.B: Sau khi Gia-cốp xuống Ai Cập, tổ tiên anh em kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sai Môi-se và A-rôn đến. Hai ông đem tổ tiên anh em ra khỏi Ai Cập và cho họ định cư tại nơi này.
vi.R: Ngày xưa, Gia-cốp và gia đình ông xuống Ai Cập. Về sau tổ tiên anh em kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cứu giúp, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sai Môi-se và A-rôn đến. Hai ông dẫn tổ tiên anh em ra khỏi Ai Cập và cho họ một quê hương trong xứ này.

decisions.choice: the Hebrew moves straight from Jacob's going to Egypt to the cry
alternatives: and the Egyptians humbled them, and your fathers cried out (Greek)
decisions.reason: The Greek translation adds "and the Egyptians oppressed them" before "your fathers cried out". The Hebrew leaves the oppression to be understood from the story of Exodus 1-3. The sense is the same either way.

decisions.choice: cried out ... sent: the pattern of the exodus
decisions.reason: Israel cried out and Yahweh heard (Exodus 2:23-25; 3:7-10). Samuel's history follows a repeated pattern: the people cry out, Yahweh sends a deliverer (verses 8, 10-11).

decisions.choice: they brought out ... and they settled them: Moses and Aaron as Yahweh's agents
decisions.reason: Both verbs are plural, so their subject is Moses and Aaron. Moses and Aaron did not themselves lead the people into the land; Samuel tells the whole rescue as the work Yahweh did through the leaders he sent. The Greek translation has "he settled them", with Yahweh as subject.

decisions.choice: Long ago Jacob and his family went down to Egypt. Later ... for help
decisions.reason: Readable explains that Jacob went with his family (Genesis 46), and that the cry came later and was a cry for help.

source.text: וַֽיִּשְׁכְּח֖וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּמְכֹּ֣ר אֹתָ֡ם בְּיַ֣ד סִֽיסְרָא֩ שַׂר־צְבָ֨א חָצ֜וֹר וּבְיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וּבְיַד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֔ב וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ בָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they forgot YHWH their God, and he sold them into [the] hand of Sisera, commander of [the] army of Hazor, and into [the] hand of [the] Philistines, and into [the] hand of [the] king of Moab, and they fought against them.

en.L: And they forgot {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sold them into [the] hand of Sisera, the commander of the army of Hazor, and into [the] hand of the Philistines, and into [the] hand of the king of Moab, and they fought against them.
en.B: But they forgot {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God, so {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sold them into the power of Sisera, who was commander of the army of Hazor, and into the power of the Philistines and the king of Moab, and these fought against them.
en.R: But your {{gender:ancestors|fathers}} forgot {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God. So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} handed them over to Sisera, the army commander from the city of Hazor. He also handed them over to the Philistines and to the king of Moab. All these enemies made war on them.

es.L: Y se olvidaron {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los vendió en [la] mano de Sísara, jefe del ejército de Hazor, y en [la] mano de los filisteos, y en [la] mano del rey de Moab, y pelearon contra ellos.
es.B: Pero se olvidaron {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios, así que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los vendió al poder de Sísara, jefe del ejército de Hazor, y al poder de los filisteos y del rey de Moab, y estos pelearon contra ellos.
es.R: Pero {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} se olvidaron {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios. Por eso {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los entregó a Sísara, el jefe del ejército de la ciudad de Hazor. También los entregó a los filisteos y al rey de Moab. Todos esos enemigos les hicieron la guerra.

fr.L: Et ils oublièrent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les vendit dans la main de Sisera, chef de l’armée de Hatsor, et dans la main des Philistins, et dans la main du roi de Moab, et ils combattirent contre eux.
fr.B: Mais ils oublièrent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les livra au pouvoir de Sisera, le chef de l’armée de Hatsor, au pouvoir des Philistins et à celui du roi de Moab, qui leur firent la guerre.
fr.R: Mais vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} ont oublié {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu. Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a livrés à Sisera, le chef de l’armée de la ville de Hatsor. Il les a aussi livrés aux Philistins et au roi de Moab. Tous ces ennemis leur ont fait la guerre.

vi.L: Nhưng họ quên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ, nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bán họ vào tay Si-sê-ra, tướng chỉ huy quân đội Hát-so, vào tay người Phi-li-tin và vào tay vua Mô-áp, và chúng đánh nhau với họ.
vi.B: Nhưng họ quên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ, nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bán họ vào quyền lực của Si-sê-ra, tướng chỉ huy quân đội Hát-so, vào quyền lực của người Phi-li-tin và của vua Mô-áp, và những kẻ ấy đánh phá họ.
vi.R: Nhưng tổ tiên anh em quên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ. Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phó họ cho Si-sê-ra, tướng chỉ huy quân đội từ thành Hát-so. Ngài cũng phó họ cho người Phi-li-tin và cho vua Mô-áp. Tất cả những kẻ thù ấy đều gây chiến với họ.

decisions.choice: forgot: left Yahweh out of their lives and loyalty
decisions.reason: To forget Yahweh is not a lapse of memory but a turning away from him to other gods, as verse 10 confesses (Judges 3:7; Deuteronomy 8:19).

decisions.choice: sold them into the hand of: gave them over to the power of
decisions.reason: As in Judges (2:14; 3:8; 4:2), Yahweh "sells" his people to their enemies: he lets them fall under foreign power, as a master hands over what is his.

decisions.choice: Sisera, the Philistines, the king of Moab: oppressors from the book of Judges
decisions.reason: Sisera commanded the army of Jabin king of Hazor (Judges 4:2); the king of Moab is Eglon (Judges 3:12-14); the Philistines oppressed Israel in the days of Samson and later (Judges 10:7; 13:1). Samuel does not list them in the order of Judges.

decisions.choice: sold them into [the] hand of (Literal); sold them into the power of (Balanced); handed them over to (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording follows the one used throughout Judges for this phrase.

decisions.choice: the city of Hazor
decisions.reason: Readable adds that Hazor was a city, so that the reader does not take it for a person.

decisions.choice: "Si-sê-ra", "Hát-so", "Mô-áp"; "tướng chỉ huy quân đội"
decisions.reason: "Si-sê-ra" and "Mô-áp" are the forms of the published Psalms and Genesis; "tướng chỉ huy quân đội" as the Samuel terms note for the commander of an army.

source.text: וַיִּזְעֲק֤וּ אֶל־יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּאמְר֣וּחָטָ֔אנוּ כִּ֤י עָזַ֨בְנוּ֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֔ה וַנַּעֲבֹ֥ד אֶת־הַבְּעָלִ֖ים וְאֶת־הָעַשְׁתָּר֑וֹת וְעַתָּ֗ה הַצִּילֵ֛נוּ מִיַּ֥ד אֹיְבֵ֖ינוּ וְנַעַבְדֶֽךָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they cried out to YHWH and said, we have sinned, for we have forsaken YHWH and we have served the Baals and the Ashtaroth; and now deliver us from [the] hand of our enemies, and we will serve you.

en.L: And they cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and said, 'We have sinned, because we have forsaken {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and have served the Baals and the Ashtaroth; and now deliver us from [the] hand of our enemies, and we will serve {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.'
en.B: Then they cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, saying, 'We have sinned. We have abandoned {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and served the Baals and the Ashtaroth. But now rescue us from the power of our enemies, and we will serve {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.'
en.R: Then they cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. They said, 'We have sinned. We turned away from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and worshiped the false gods called the Baals and the goddesses called the Ashtaroth. But now save us from our enemies, and we will worship {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.'

es.L: Y clamaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y dijeron: “Hemos pecado, porque hemos abandonado {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y hemos servido a los baales y a las astartés; y ahora líbranos de [la] mano de nuestros enemigos, y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} serviremos”.
es.B: Entonces clamaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, diciendo: “Hemos pecado. Hemos abandonado {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y hemos servido a los baales y a las astartés. Pero ahora líbranos del poder de nuestros enemigos, y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} serviremos”.
es.R: Entonces clamaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Dijeron: “Hemos pecado. Nos apartamos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y adoramos a los dioses falsos llamados baales y a las diosas llamadas astartés. Pero ahora sálvanos de nuestros enemigos, y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} adoraremos”.

fr.L: Et ils crièrent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} et dirent : “Nous avons péché, car nous avons abandonné {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et nous avons servi les Baals et les Ashtaroth ; et maintenant, délivre-nous de la main de nos ennemis, et nous {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} servirons.”
fr.B: Alors ils crièrent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : “Nous avons péché. Nous avons abandonné {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pour servir les Baals et les Ashtaroth. Mais maintenant, délivre-nous du pouvoir de nos ennemis, et nous {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} servirons.”
fr.R: Alors ils ont appelé {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au secours. Ils ont dit : “Nous avons péché. Nous nous sommes détournés {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et nous avons adoré les faux dieux appelés Baals et les déesses appelées Ashtaroth. Mais maintenant, sauve-nous de nos ennemis, et nous {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}adorerons.”

vi.L: Họ kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và nói: 'Chúng con đã phạm tội, vì chúng con đã lìa bỏ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà phục vụ các Ba-anh và các Át-tạt-tê; nhưng bây giờ xin giải cứu chúng con khỏi tay kẻ thù chúng con, và chúng con sẽ phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.'
vi.B: Bấy giờ họ kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: 'Chúng con đã phạm tội. Chúng con đã lìa bỏ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà phục vụ các Ba-anh và các Át-tạt-tê. Nhưng bây giờ xin giải cứu chúng con khỏi quyền lực của kẻ thù, và chúng con sẽ phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.'
vi.R: Bấy giờ họ kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: 'Chúng con đã phạm tội. Chúng con đã từ bỏ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà thờ các tà thần gọi là Ba-anh và các nữ thần gọi là Át-tạt-tê. Nhưng bây giờ xin cứu chúng con khỏi kẻ thù, và chúng con sẽ thờ phượng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.'

decisions.choice: and they said: the reading spoken aloud
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew has "and he said", singular; the reading marked for reading aloud has the plural "and they said", which fits "they cried out". The plural is followed here. The sense is the same.

decisions.choice: the Baals and the Ashtaroth: the gods and goddesses of Canaan
decisions.reason: Baal was the Canaanite storm god and Ashtoreth (Astarte) a goddess of fertility and war. The plurals cover their many local forms. Samuel had called on Israel to put them away (7:3-4).

decisions.choice: We have sinned ... deliver us, and we will serve you
decisions.reason: The words are close to Israel's confession in Judges 10:10-16. Samuel lets the ancestors' own prayer show that serving Yahweh, not having a king, was the way out of oppression.

decisions.choice: single quotation marks for the ancestors' words
decisions.reason: The people's prayer is quoted inside Samuel's speech, so it takes single quotation marks.

decisions.choice: the false gods called the Baals and the goddesses called the Ashtaroth
decisions.reason: Readable explains who the Baals and the Ashtaroth were, as in Judges 2:13.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח יְהוָה֙ אֶת־יְרֻבַּ֣עַל וְאֶת־בְּדָ֔ן וְאֶת־יִפְתָּ֖ח וְאֶת־שְׁמוּאֵ֑ל וַיַּצֵּ֨ל אֶתְכֶ֜ם מִיַּ֤ד אֹֽיְבֵיכֶם֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב וַתֵּשְׁב֖וּ בֶּֽטַח׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent YHWH Jerubbaal and Bedan and Jephthah and Samuel, and he delivered you from [the] hand of your enemies around, and you dwelt [in] security.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sent Jerubbaal and Bedan and Jephthah and Samuel, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} delivered you from [the] hand of your enemies all around, and you dwelt in security.
en.B: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sent Jerubbaal, Bedan, Jephthah and Samuel, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rescued you from the power of the enemies around you, and you lived in safety.
en.R: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sent Jerubbaal (also called Gideon), Bedan, Jephthah and Samuel. He used them to save you from the enemies all around you, and you lived in safety.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} envió a Jerobaal y a Bedán y a Jefté y a Samuel, y {{plural_you:los|os}} libró de [la] mano de {{plural_you:sus enemigos|vuestros enemigos}} de alrededor, y {{plural_you:habitaron|habitasteis}} seguros.
es.B: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} envió a Jerobaal, Bedán, Jefté y Samuel, y {{plural_you:los|os}} libró del poder de los enemigos que {{plural_you:los|os}} rodeaban, y {{plural_you:vivieron|vivisteis}} seguros.
es.R: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} envió a Jerobaal (también llamado Gedeón), a Bedán, a Jefté y a Samuel. Por medio de ellos {{plural_you:los|os}} salvó de los enemigos que {{plural_you:los|os}} rodeaban, y {{plural_you:vivieron|vivisteis}} seguros.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} envoya Yeroubbaal, et Bedân, et Jephté, et Samuel, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous délivra de la main de vos ennemis tout autour, et vous avez habité en sécurité.
fr.B: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} envoya Yeroubbaal, Bedân, Jephté et Samuel, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous délivra du pouvoir des ennemis qui vous entouraient, et vous avez vécu en sécurité.
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a envoyé Yeroubbaal (qu’on appelle aussi Gédéon), Bedân, Jephté et Samuel. Il s’est servi d’eux pour vous sauver des ennemis qui vous entouraient, et vous avez vécu en sécurité.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sai Giê-ru-ba-anh, Bê-đan, Giép-thê và Sa-mu-ên, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu anh em khỏi tay kẻ thù chung quanh anh em, và anh em được sống yên ổn.
vi.B: Rồi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sai Giê-ru-ba-anh, Bê-đan, Giép-thê và Sa-mu-ên đến, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu anh em khỏi quyền lực của kẻ thù chung quanh, và anh em được sống an toàn.
vi.R: Rồi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sai Giê-ru-ba-anh (cũng gọi là Ghê-đê-ôn), Bê-đan, Giép-thê và Sa-mu-ên đến. Ngài dùng họ để cứu anh em khỏi các kẻ thù chung quanh, và anh em được sống an toàn.

decisions.choice: Bedan
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has Bedan, a name not found among the judges in the book of Judges (a Bedan of the tribe of Manasseh is named in 1 Chronicles 7:17). The Greek and Syriac translations read "Barak", the leader who fought Sisera with Deborah (Judges 4), which fits the mention of Sisera in verse 9. Bedan may be another name for a known judge, or the text may have changed in copying. The Hebrew text is kept.

decisions.choice: Samuel
decisions.reason: Samuel names himself last among the deliverers, as the one who led Israel against the Philistines (7:7-14). Some Greek manuscripts and the Syriac translation read "Samson" instead, which avoids Samuel speaking of himself in the third person. The Hebrew text is kept.

decisions.choice: Jerubbaal is Gideon
decisions.reason: Gideon was given the name Jerubbaal, "let Baal contend", after he tore down Baal's altar (Judges 6:32).

decisions.choice: he delivered you: Yahweh is the rescuer
decisions.reason: The leaders are sent, but the one who delivers is Yahweh; the verb is singular and its subject is Yahweh. This prepares for verse 12: Israel already had a king who rescued them.

decisions.choice: (also called Gideon)
decisions.reason: Readable gives the better known name, so that the reader recognizes the judge.

decisions.choice: He used them to save you
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the LORD saved the people through the leaders he sent.

decisions.choice: "Yeroubbaal", "Bedân", "Jephté"
decisions.reason: "Jephté" is the established French name; Gideon's other name and the unknown Bedan are transcribed as the other names of this block are, with "ou" for u.

decisions.choice: "Jerobaal", "Bedán", "Jefté"; "Gedeón" (R); "Sísara", "Hazor" (verse 9)
decisions.reason: The judges and their enemies in their usual Spanish forms; Readable adds Gideon's better-known name, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Giê-ru-ba-anh", "Bê-đan", "Giép-thê"; "Ghê-đê-ôn" at Readable
decisions.reason: "Giép-thê" and "Ghê-đê-ôn" are the forms of the Vietnamese Hebrews 11:32; the others follow the usual transliteration.

source.text: וַתִּרְא֗וּ כִּֽי־נָחָ֞שׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ בְּנֵֽי־עַמּוֹן֮ בָּ֣א עֲלֵיכֶם֒ וַתֹּ֣אמְרוּ לִ֔י לֹ֕א כִּי־מֶ֖לֶךְ יִמְלֹ֣ךְ עָלֵ֑ינוּ וַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם מַלְכְּכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And you saw that Nahash king of [the] sons of Ammon came against you, and you said to me, no, but a king shall reign over us; and YHWH your God [was] your king.

en.L: And when you saw that Nahash, the king of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Ammon, came against you, you said to me, 'No, but a king shall reign over us,' when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God was your king.
en.B: But when you saw that Nahash king of the Ammonites was coming against you, you said to me, 'No! A king must reign over us,' though {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God was your king.
en.R: But when you saw that Nahash, the king of the Ammonites, was coming to attack you, you told me, 'No! We want a king to rule over us.' You said this even though {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God was already your king.

es.L: Y cuando {{plural_you:vieron|visteis}} que Nahas, rey de los hijos de Amón, venía contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, me {{plural_you:dijeron|dijisteis}}: “No, sino que un rey reinará sobre nosotros”, siendo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} {{plural_you:su rey|vuestro rey}}.
es.B: Pero cuando {{plural_you:vieron|visteis}} que Nahas, rey de los amonitas, venía contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, me {{plural_you:dijeron|dijisteis}}: “¡No! Un rey debe reinar sobre nosotros”, aunque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} era {{plural_you:su rey|vuestro rey}}.
es.R: Pero cuando {{plural_you:vieron|visteis}} que Nahas, el rey de los amonitas, venía a {{plural_you:atacarlos|atacaros}}, me {{plural_you:dijeron|dijisteis}}: “¡No! Queremos un rey que nos gobierne”. Lo {{plural_you:dijeron|dijisteis}} aunque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} ya era {{plural_you:su rey|vuestro rey}}.

fr.L: Et quand vous avez vu que Nahash, roi des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Ammon, venait contre vous, vous m’avez dit : “Non, mais un roi régnera sur nous”, alors que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu était votre roi.
fr.B: Mais quand vous avez vu Nahash, roi des Ammonites, marcher contre vous, vous m’avez dit : “Non ! Il faut qu’un roi règne sur nous”, alors que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu était votre roi.
fr.R: Mais quand vous avez vu Nahash, le roi des Ammonites, venir vous attaquer, vous m’avez dit : “Non ! Nous voulons un roi pour régner sur nous.” Vous avez dit cela alors que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu était déjà votre roi.

vi.L: Khi anh em thấy Na-hách, vua của con cháu Am-môn, đến đánh anh em, thì anh em nói với tôi: 'Không, nhưng phải có một vua cai trị chúng tôi,' trong khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời anh em là vua của anh em.
vi.B: Nhưng khi thấy Na-hách vua Am-môn kéo đến đánh anh em, anh em nói với tôi: 'Không! Phải có một vua cai trị chúng tôi,' dù {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời anh em là vua của anh em.
vi.R: Nhưng khi anh em thấy Na-hách, vua người Am-môn, kéo đến tấn công, anh em nói với tôi: 'Không! Chúng tôi muốn có một vua cai trị.' Anh em nói vậy dù {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời anh em đã là vua của anh em rồi.

decisions.choice: Nahash: the Ammonite king of chapter 11
decisions.reason: Nahash besieged Jabesh-gilead and was defeated by Saul (11:1-11). Samuel ties the people's demand for a king to their fear of him, though the request itself is first told in 8:4-5; the threat from Ammon may already have been growing then.

decisions.choice: No, but a king shall reign over us
decisions.reason: The people's words echo their answer in 8:19, "No, but there shall be a king over us". Samuel quotes them back to show what they rejected.

decisions.choice: Yahweh your God was your king
decisions.reason: The heart of Samuel's charge: Israel already had a king, Yahweh, who had rescued them again and again (verses 8-11). Asking for a human king was a rejection of him (8:7; 10:19).

decisions.choice: single quotation marks for the people's earlier words
decisions.reason: Samuel quotes what the people said to him, inside his own speech.

decisions.choice: the Ammonites
decisions.reason: "Sons of Ammon" is the name of the people; Balanced and Readable call them the Ammonites.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה הִנֵּ֥ה הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּחַרְתֶּ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁאֶלְתֶּ֑ם וְהִנֵּ֨ה נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם מֶֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, behold, the king whom you have chosen, whom you asked for; and behold, has set YHWH over you a king.

en.L: And now, here [is] the king whom you have chosen, whom you have asked for; and look, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has set a king over you.
en.B: Now here is the king you have chosen, the one you asked for. See, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has set a king over you.
en.R: So here is the king you chose. You asked for him, and now {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has given you a king to rule over you.

es.L: Y ahora, he aquí el rey que {{plural_you:han escogido|habéis escogido}}, el que {{plural_you:han pedido|habéis pedido}}; y miren, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha puesto un rey sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Ahora, aquí está el rey que {{plural_you:escogieron|escogisteis}}, el que {{plural_you:pidieron|pedisteis}}. {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha puesto un rey sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Así que aquí está el rey que {{plural_you:escogieron|escogisteis}}. {{plural_you:Ustedes lo pidieron|Vosotros lo pedisteis}}, y ahora {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} ha dado un rey que {{plural_you:los|os}} gobierne.

fr.L: Et maintenant, voici le roi que vous avez choisi, que vous avez demandé ; et voici, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a établi un roi sur vous.
fr.B: Voici donc maintenant le roi que vous avez choisi, celui que vous avez demandé. Voyez, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a établi un roi sur vous.
fr.R: Voici donc le roi que vous avez choisi. Vous l’avez demandé, et maintenant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a donné un roi pour régner sur vous.

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, đây [là] vua mà anh em đã chọn, vua mà anh em đã xin; kìa, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã lập một vua trên anh em.
vi.B: Bây giờ, đây là vua anh em đã chọn, là người anh em đã xin. Kìa, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã lập một vua trên anh em.
vi.R: Vậy đây là vua anh em đã chọn. Anh em đã xin có vua, và bây giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban cho anh em một vua để cai trị anh em.

decisions.choice: whom you asked for: a play on Saul's name
decisions.reason: The verb "ask" has the same letters as the name Saul, which means "asked for". The people asked for a king (8:10), and the king they were given is Saul, the "asked-for" one. The same verb returns in verses 17 and 19, where asking for a king is called evil.

decisions.choice: you have chosen ... Yahweh has set: both are true
decisions.reason: The king is the people's choice, made at their own request, and yet it is Yahweh who has given him (10:24). Samuel holds the two side by side: Yahweh granted what the people wanted, and both the people and their king now answer to him (verses 14-15).

decisions.choice: here [is] ... look (Literal); here is ... See (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The two pointing words direct the eye to the king and to Yahweh's act. Literal has "here [is]" and "look"; Balanced uses "here is" and "see"; Readable leaves them out.

source.text: אִם־תִּֽירְא֣וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֗ה וַעֲבַדְתֶּ֤ם אֹתוֹ֙ וּשְׁמַעְתֶּ֣ם בְּקֹל֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א תַמְר֖וּ אֶת־פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וִהְיִתֶ֣ם גַּם־אַתֶּ֗ם וְגַם־הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָלַ֣ךְ עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם אַחַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: If you will fear YHWH and serve him and listen to his voice and not rebel against [the] mouth of YHWH, and will be both you and also the king who reigns over you after YHWH your God.

en.L: If you fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and listen to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice and do not rebel against the mouth of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, then both you and the king who reigns over you will be after {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.B: If you fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, obey {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice and do not rebel against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s command, then both you and the king who reigns over you will be followers of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.R: If you respect {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and worship {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, if you obey {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and do not refuse to do what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} commands, then you and the king who rules over you will keep following {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.

es.L: Si {{plural_you:temen|teméis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} {{plural_you:sirven|servís}} y {{plural_you:escuchan|escucháis}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz y no {{plural_you:se rebelan|os rebeláis}} contra la boca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, entonces tanto {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} como el rey que reina sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} [irán] en pos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}.
es.B: Si {{plural_you:temen|teméis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} {{plural_you:sirven|servís}}, {{plural_you:obedecen|obedecéis}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz y no {{plural_you:se rebelan|os rebeláis}} contra el mandato {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, entonces tanto {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} como el rey que reina sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} serán seguidores {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}.
es.R: Si {{plural_you:respetan|respetáis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} {{plural_you:adoran|adoráis}}, si {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} {{plural_you:obedecen|obedecéis}} y no {{plural_you:se niegan|os negáis}} a hacer lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} manda, entonces {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y el rey que {{plural_you:los|os}} gobierna seguirán fieles {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}.

fr.L: Si vous craignez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servez et écoutez {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix, et ne vous révoltez pas contre la bouche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, alors vous et aussi le roi qui règne sur vous, vous serez à la suite {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu.
fr.B: Si vous craignez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, si vous {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servez, si vous obéissez à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix et ne vous révoltez pas contre l’ordre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, alors vous et le roi qui règne sur vous, vous serez fidèles {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} votre Dieu.
fr.R: Si vous respectez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et si vous {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}adorez, si vous {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} obéissez et si vous ne refusez pas de faire ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ordonne, alors vous et le roi qui règne sur vous, vous continuerez à suivre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu.

vi.L: Nếu anh em kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nghe theo tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và không chống lại miệng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, thì cả anh em lẫn vua cai trị anh em sẽ đi theo {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em.
vi.B: Nếu anh em kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vâng theo tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và không chống lại mệnh lệnh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, thì cả anh em lẫn vua cai trị anh em sẽ là những người đi theo {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em.
vi.R: Nếu anh em tôn kính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và thờ phượng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nếu anh em vâng lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và không từ chối làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} truyền dạy, thì anh em và vua cai trị anh em sẽ cứ tiếp tục đi theo {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em.

decisions.choice: then both you and the king ... will be after Yahweh your God
alternatives: if ... and if both you and the king who reigns over you follow Yahweh your God, [it will be well]
decisions.reason: The sentence begins with "if", and verse 15 has an "if" with a clear "then" ("the hand of Yahweh will be against you"). Here the "then" is less clear. It is taken to be the last clause: if the people are loyal, they and their king will go on following Yahweh as his people. Others read the last clause as part of the "if" and take the sentence as broken off, leaving the reader to supply "it will be well". The Greek translation does not settle it.

decisions.choice: fear Yahweh: hold him in awe and be loyal to him
decisions.reason: To fear Yahweh is to honor him as God and to live in obedience to him. The verbs that follow (serve, listen, not rebel) spell out what it means.

decisions.choice: rebel against the mouth of Yahweh: refuse what Yahweh commands
decisions.reason: The mouth stands for what Yahweh says, his command (Numbers 20:24; Deuteronomy 1:26, 43).

decisions.choice: be after Yahweh: follow him as his loyal people
decisions.reason: To be or go "after" someone is to follow him as leader and to be on his side (2 Samuel 2:10; 1 Kings 14:8).

decisions.choice: the LORD's command; followers of (Balanced); what the LORD commands; keep following (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of "mouth" and of "be after". Readable repeats "if" to make the long condition easier to follow.

decisions.choice: respect ... worship
decisions.reason: Readable says "respect" for "fear" and "worship" for "serve", the sense these words have when used of God.

decisions.choice: "kính sợ" (L, B); "tôn kính" (R) for fearing the LORD
decisions.reason: As the Psalms terms note: the fear of the LORD is "sự kính sợ CHÚA", and Readable says "tôn kính CHÚA".

source.text: וְאִם־לֹ֤א תִשְׁמְעוּ֙ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֔ה וּמְרִיתֶ֖ם אֶת־פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְהָיְתָ֧ה יַד־יְהוָ֛ה בָּכֶ֖ם וּבַאֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And if not you will listen to [the] voice of YHWH and you rebel against [the] mouth of YHWH, and will be [the] hand of YHWH against you and against your fathers.

en.L: But if you do not listen to the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and you rebel against the mouth of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, then the hand of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be against you and against your fathers.
en.B: But if you do not obey the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and you rebel against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s command, then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s hand will be against you, as it was against your {{gender:ancestors|fathers}}.
en.R: But if you refuse to obey {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and refuse to do what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} commands, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will punish you, just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} punished your {{gender:ancestors|fathers}}.

es.L: Pero si no {{plural_you:escuchan|escucháis}} la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y {{plural_you:se rebelan|os rebeláis}} contra la boca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, entonces la mano {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} estará contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y contra {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}}.
es.B: Pero si no {{plural_you:obedecen|obedecéis}} la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y {{plural_you:se rebelan|os rebeláis}} contra el mandato {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, la mano {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} estará contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, como estuvo contra {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}}.
es.R: Pero si {{plural_you:se niegan|os negáis}} a obedecer {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y a hacer lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} manda, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:los|os}} castigará, como castigó a {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}}.

fr.L: Mais si vous n’écoutez pas la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et que vous vous révoltez contre la bouche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, alors la main {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} sera contre vous et contre vos pères.
fr.B: Mais si vous n’obéissez pas à la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et que vous vous révoltez contre l’ordre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, la main {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} sera contre vous comme elle l’a été contre vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}.
fr.R: Mais si vous refusez d’obéir {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} et de faire ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ordonne, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous punira, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a puni vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}.

vi.L: Nhưng nếu anh em không nghe theo tiếng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và chống lại miệng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, thì tay {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ nghịch cùng anh em và nghịch cùng tổ phụ anh em.
vi.B: Nhưng nếu anh em không vâng theo tiếng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và chống lại mệnh lệnh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, thì tay {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ chống lại anh em, như đã chống lại tổ tiên anh em.
vi.R: Nhưng nếu anh em không chịu vâng lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và không chịu làm điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} truyền dạy, thì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ trừng phạt anh em, như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trừng phạt tổ tiên anh em.

decisions.choice: against you and against your fathers: as it was against your fathers
alternatives: against you and against your king (Greek)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "against you and against your fathers", which is hard, since the fathers are long dead. It is taken to mean that Yahweh's hand will be against the people as it was against their fathers (verse 9). The Greek translation reads "against you and against your king", which matches verse 14 and verse 25.

decisions.choice: the hand of Yahweh will be against you: Yahweh will act against you to punish
decisions.reason: Yahweh's hand is his power in action. Against an enemy it strikes (5:6, 9; 7:13); here it is turned against his own people if they rebel.

decisions.choice: as it was against your ancestors (Balanced); just as he punished your ancestors (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the sense taken in the meaning decision. Literal keeps the Hebrew as it stands.

decisions.choice: will punish you
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the picture of Yahweh's hand against someone.

source.text: גַּם־עַתָּה֙ הִתְיַצְּב֣וּ וּרְא֔וּ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֥ר הַגָּד֖וֹל הַזֶּ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עֹשֶׂ֖ה לְעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Also now present yourselves and see this great thing which YHWH [is] doing before your eyes.

en.L: Even now, present yourselves and see this great thing which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is about to do before your eyes.
en.B: Now then, take your stand and watch this great thing {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is about to do before your eyes.
en.R: Now stay where you are and watch the amazing thing {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is going to do right in front of you.

es.L: Ahora, pues, {{plural_you:preséntense|presentaos}} y {{plural_you:vean|ved}} esta gran cosa que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} va a hacer delante de {{plural_you:sus ojos|vuestros ojos}}.
es.B: Así que ahora {{plural_you:quédense|quedaos}} firmes y {{plural_you:observen|observad}} esta gran cosa que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} va a hacer ante {{plural_you:sus ojos|vuestros ojos}}.
es.R: Ahora {{plural_you:quédense donde están|quedaos donde estáis}} y {{plural_you:miren|mirad}} lo asombroso que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} va a hacer delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

fr.L: Maintenant encore, présentez-vous et voyez cette grande chose que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} va faire sous vos yeux.
fr.B: Maintenant donc, tenez-vous là et regardez la grande chose que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} va faire sous vos yeux.
fr.R: Maintenant, restez où vous êtes et regardez la chose extraordinaire que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} va faire devant vous.

vi.L: Ngay bây giờ, hãy đứng đó và xem việc lớn lao này mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sắp làm trước mắt anh em.
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ hãy đứng yên mà xem việc lớn lao {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sắp làm trước mắt anh em.
vi.R: Bây giờ hãy đứng yên tại chỗ và xem việc kỳ diệu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sắp làm ngay trước mặt anh em.

decisions.choice: present yourselves and see: the words of Moses at the Red Sea
decisions.reason: Moses told the people, "Stand firm and see the salvation of Yahweh" (Exodus 14:13). Samuel uses the same verbs for a sign that will show Yahweh's power again, this time against the people's sin.

decisions.choice: is about to do: the participle points to something just ahead
decisions.reason: The verb form describes an action that is about to happen. The sign comes in verse 18, after Samuel calls on Yahweh.

decisions.choice: present yourselves (Literal); take your stand (Balanced); stay where you are (Readable)
decisions.reason: The same verb as in verse 7. Balanced keeps the courtroom picture of standing for a hearing; Readable says it simply.

source.text: הֲל֤וֹא קְצִיר־חִטִּים֙ הַיּ֔וֹם אֶקְרָא֙ אֶל־יְהוָ֔ה וְיִתֵּ֥ן קֹל֖וֹת וּמָטָ֑ר וּדְע֣וּ וּרְא֗וּ כִּֽי־רָעַתְכֶ֤ם רַבָּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֲשִׂיתֶם֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לִשְׁא֥וֹל לָכֶ֖ם מֶֽלֶךְ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: [Is it] not [the] harvest of wheat today? I will call to YHWH and he will give voices and rain, and know and see that your evil [is] great which you did in [the] eyes of YHWH, to ask for yourselves a king.

en.L: Is it not wheat harvest today? I will call to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will give thunder and rain; and know and see that your evil is great which you have done in the eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} by asking for yourselves a king."
en.B: Is this not the time of the wheat harvest? I will call on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will send thunder and rain. Then you will know and see how great is the evil you have done in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} by asking for a king for yourselves."
en.R: It is the time of the wheat harvest now, when it does not rain. But I will pray to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will send thunder and rain. Then you will understand how wicked it was in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for you to ask for a king."

es.L: ¿No es hoy la siega del trigo? Clamaré {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dará truenos y lluvia; y {{plural_you:sepan|sabed}} y {{plural_you:vean|ved}} que es grande {{plural_you:su maldad|vuestra maldad}}, la que {{plural_you:han hecho|habéis hecho}} a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} al {{plural_you:pedirse|pediros}} un rey».
es.B: ¿No es este el tiempo de la siega del trigo? Invocaré {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} enviará truenos y lluvia. Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} y {{plural_you:verán|veréis}} cuán grande es el mal que {{plural_you:han hecho|habéis hecho}} a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} al pedir un rey para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}».
es.R: Ahora es el tiempo de la siega del trigo, cuando no llueve. Pero voy a orar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} enviará truenos y lluvia. Entonces {{plural_you:entenderán|entenderéis}} qué malo fue a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que {{plural_you:pidieran|pidierais}} un rey».

fr.L: N’est-ce pas aujourd’hui la moisson du blé ? Je crierai {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} donnera des voix et de la pluie ; et sachez et voyez que votre mal est grand, que vous avez fait aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, en demandant pour vous un roi. »
fr.B: N’est-ce pas maintenant la moisson du blé ? Je vais invoquer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} enverra le tonnerre et la pluie. Alors vous saurez et vous verrez combien est grand le mal que vous avez commis aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} en demandant un roi pour vous. »
fr.R: C’est maintenant la moisson du blé, la saison où il ne pleut pas. Mais je vais prier {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} enverra le tonnerre et la pluie. Alors vous comprendrez combien c’était mal, aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, de demander un roi. »

vi.L: Hôm nay chẳng phải là mùa gặt lúa mì sao? Tôi sẽ kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ cho sấm sét và mưa; rồi anh em hãy biết và thấy rằng điều ác anh em đã làm trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là lớn lắm, khi xin cho mình một vua."
vi.B: Bây giờ chẳng phải đang mùa gặt lúa mì sao? Tôi sẽ kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ cho sấm sét và mưa. Bấy giờ anh em sẽ biết và thấy điều ác anh em đã làm trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lớn biết bao, khi xin cho mình một vua."
vi.R: Bây giờ đang là mùa gặt lúa mì, lúc trời không mưa. Nhưng tôi sẽ cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ cho sấm sét và mưa. Bấy giờ anh em sẽ hiểu rằng việc anh em xin có vua là điều rất xấu xa trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."

decisions.choice: wheat harvest: early summer, in the dry season
decisions.reason: In Israel wheat is harvested in late spring and early summer, when rain almost never falls. A storm at that time would be a plain sign from Yahweh, and could also ruin the crop that was waiting to be gathered.

decisions.choice: voices: thunder
decisions.reason: The plural of the word for "voice" is the regular word for thunder, heard as the voice of God (Exodus 9:23; Psalm 29:3).

decisions.choice: know and see: the purpose of the sign
decisions.reason: The two commands follow the promise of the sign and state its purpose: when the storm comes, the people are to recognize their wrong.

decisions.choice: your evil is great ... by asking for yourselves a king
decisions.reason: Samuel does not say that kingship itself is evil; Yahweh has given the king (verse 13). The evil was asking for a king in place of Yahweh as king (verse 12; 8:7).

decisions.choice: send thunder and rain
decisions.reason: "Give voices" is the Hebrew way of saying that God sends thunder. Literal keeps "give"; Balanced and Readable say "send".

decisions.choice: It is the time of the wheat harvest now, when it does not rain. But
decisions.reason: Readable turns the question into a statement and says why the season matters, so that the sign is clear to a reader who does not know the climate of Israel.

source.text: וַיִּקְרָ֤א שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶל־יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּתֵּ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה קֹלֹ֥ת וּמָטָ֖ר בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַיִּירָ֨א כָל־הָעָ֥ם מְאֹ֛ד אֶת־יְהוָ֖ה וְאֶת־שְׁמוּאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And called Samuel to YHWH, and gave YHWH voices and rain on the day that, and feared all the people greatly YHWH and Samuel.

en.L: And Samuel called to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave thunder and rain on that day; and all the people greatly feared {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and Samuel.
en.B: So Samuel called on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and that same day {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sent thunder and rain. All the people were filled with fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and of Samuel.
en.R: So Samuel prayed to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and that same day {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sent thunder and rain. Then all the people were very afraid of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and of Samuel.

es.L: Y Samuel clamó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dio truenos y lluvia aquel día; y todo el pueblo temió en gran manera {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y a Samuel.
es.B: Entonces Samuel invocó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y ese mismo día {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} envió truenos y lluvia. Todo el pueblo se llenó de temor ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} y ante Samuel.
es.R: Así que Samuel oró {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y ese mismo día {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} envió truenos y lluvia. Entonces todo el pueblo tuvo mucho miedo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y de Samuel.

fr.L: Et Samuel cria {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} donna des voix et de la pluie ce jour-là ; et tout le peuple craignit beaucoup {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et Samuel.
fr.B: Samuel invoqua donc {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et le jour même {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} envoya le tonnerre et la pluie. Tout le peuple fut rempli de crainte devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et devant Samuel.
