fr.R: Alors Samuel a prié {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et le jour même {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a envoyé le tonnerre et la pluie. Tout le peuple a eu très peur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et de Samuel.

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và trong ngày ấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho sấm sét và mưa; toàn dân vô cùng kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và Sa-mu-ên.
vi.B: Vậy Sa-mu-ên kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và ngay ngày hôm ấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho sấm sét và mưa. Toàn dân đều kinh sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và Sa-mu-ên.
vi.R: Vậy Sa-mu-ên cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và ngay hôm ấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho sấm sét và mưa. Bấy giờ toàn dân rất sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và Sa-mu-ên.

decisions.choice: feared: awe and terror together
decisions.reason: The people fear Yahweh in the sense of verse 14, honoring him, and they are also afraid of what he may do to them, as verse 19 shows. Samuel is feared too, because Yahweh has answered his prayer.

decisions.choice: feared Yahweh and Samuel: as Israel feared Yahweh and Moses
decisions.reason: After the crossing of the sea, the people "feared Yahweh and believed in Yahweh and in Moses his servant" (Exodus 14:31). Samuel is shown as a prophet like Moses.

decisions.choice: were filled with fear of (Balanced); were very afraid of (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable choose words that hold both awe and fright.

source.text: וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ כָל־הָעָ֜ם אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל הִתְפַּלֵּ֧ל בְּעַד־עֲבָדֶ֛יךָ אֶל־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ וְאַל־נָמ֑וּת כִּֽי־יָסַ֤פְנוּ עַל־כָּל־חַטֹּאתֵ֨ינוּ֙ רָעָ֔ה לִשְׁאֹ֥ל לָ֖נוּ מֶֽלֶךְ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And said all the people to Samuel, pray for your slaves to YHWH your God, and not let us die, for we have added to all our sins evil, to ask for ourselves a king.

en.L: And all the people said to Samuel, "Pray for your servants to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, so that we do not die, for we have added to all our sins an evil, by asking for ourselves a king."
en.B: All the people said to Samuel, "Pray for your servants to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, or we will die! To all our other sins we have added this evil: we asked for a king for ourselves."
en.R: All the people begged Samuel, "Please pray to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God for us, your servants, so that we will not die. We have sinned in many ways, and now we have added one more evil thing: we asked for a king."

es.L: Y todo el pueblo dijo a Samuel: «Ora por tus siervos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios, para que no muramos, porque hemos añadido a todos nuestros pecados un mal, al pedirnos un rey».
es.B: Todo el pueblo le dijo a Samuel: «Ora por tus siervos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios, ¡o moriremos! A todos nuestros pecados les hemos añadido este mal: pedimos un rey para nosotros».
es.R: Todo el pueblo le rogó a Samuel: «Por favor, ora {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios por nosotros, tus siervos, para que no muramos. Hemos pecado de muchas maneras, y ahora hemos añadido otra maldad más: pedimos un rey».

fr.L: Et tout le peuple dit à Samuel : « Prie pour tes serviteurs {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, pour que nous ne mourions pas, car nous avons ajouté à tous nos péchés un mal, en demandant pour nous un roi. »
fr.B: Tout le peuple dit à Samuel : « Prie {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu pour tes serviteurs, sinon nous allons mourir ! À tous nos péchés, nous avons ajouté ce mal : nous avons demandé un roi pour nous. »
fr.R: Tout le peuple a supplié Samuel : « S’il te plaît, prie {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu pour nous, tes serviteurs, pour que nous ne mourions pas. Nous avons péché de bien des manières, et maintenant nous avons fait encore une chose mauvaise : nous avons demandé un roi. »

vi.L: Toàn dân nói với Sa-mu-ên: "Xin ông cầu nguyện cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông cho các đầy tớ ông, để chúng tôi khỏi chết, vì chúng tôi đã thêm vào mọi tội lỗi của mình một điều ác nữa, là xin cho mình một vua."
vi.B: Toàn dân nói với Sa-mu-ên: "Xin ông cầu nguyện cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông cho các đầy tớ ông, kẻo chúng tôi chết! Chúng tôi đã thêm vào mọi tội lỗi khác điều ác này: chúng tôi đã xin cho mình một vua."
vi.R: Toàn dân nài xin Sa-mu-ên: "Xin ông cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông cho chúng tôi là đầy tớ của ông, để chúng tôi khỏi chết. Chúng tôi đã phạm tội nhiều cách, và nay còn thêm một điều ác nữa: chúng tôi đã xin có vua."

decisions.choice: your servants: a humble way of speaking of oneself
decisions.reason: Speaking to someone of higher standing, a person called himself "your slave" as a mark of respect and dependence. The people place themselves under Samuel as they ask him to pray for them.

decisions.choice: pray for your servants: Samuel stands between the people and Yahweh
decisions.reason: The people ask Samuel to intercede, as Israel asked Moses (Numbers 21:7). Samuel answers in verse 23 that he will not stop praying for them.

decisions.choice: Yahweh your God: said to Samuel
decisions.reason: The people speak of "your God" to Samuel, as one who stands close to Yahweh. In their fear they turn to Samuel as the one Yahweh hears. Samuel answers that Yahweh will not abandon "his people" (verse 22).

decisions.choice: your servants (every level)
decisions.reason: The people are not literally owned; this is the polite way of speaking of oneself, which has "your servant(s)" at every level in these books.

decisions.choice: "tes serviteurs" at every level
decisions.reason: The people speak of themselves in humility to Samuel (m1); as the Samuel terms note settles for "your servant" in speech to a superior, French says "serviteur" at every level.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֤ל אֶל־הָעָם֙ אַל־תִּירָ֔אוּ אַתֶּ֣ם עֲשִׂיתֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת כָּל־הָרָעָ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את אַ֗ךְ אַל־תָּס֨וּרוּ֙ מֵאַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַעֲבַדְתֶּ֥ם אֶת־יְהוָ֖ה בְּכָל־לְבַבְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Samuel to the people, not be afraid; you, you have done all this evil; only not turn aside from after YHWH, and serve YHWH with all your heart.

en.L: And Samuel said to the people, "Do not be afraid. You, you have done all this evil; only do not turn aside from following {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, but serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with all your heart.
en.B: Samuel said to the people, "Do not be afraid. You have done all this evil, yes; but do not turn away from following {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with all your heart.
en.R: Samuel answered the people, "Do not be afraid. It is true that you have done this evil thing. But do not stop following {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with your whole heart.

es.L: Y Samuel dijo al pueblo: «No {{plural_you:teman|temáis}}. {{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotros}}, {{plural_you:ustedes han hecho|vosotros habéis hecho}} todo este mal; solamente no {{plural_you:se aparten|os apartéis}} de en pos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, sino {{plural_you:sirvan|servid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con todo {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}}.
es.B: Samuel le dijo al pueblo: «No {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo. Es cierto que {{plural_you:han hecho|habéis hecho}} todo este mal; pero no {{plural_you:se aparten|os apartéis}} de seguir {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. {{plural_you:Sirvan|Servid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con todo {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}}.
es.R: Samuel le respondió al pueblo: «No {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo. Es verdad que {{plural_you:han hecho|habéis hecho}} esta maldad. Pero no {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} de seguir {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. {{plural_you:Sirvan|Servid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con todo {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}}.

fr.L: Et Samuel dit au peuple : « Ne craignez pas. Vous, vous avez fait tout ce mal ; seulement, ne vous détournez pas de la suite {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, mais servez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} de tout votre cœur.
fr.B: Samuel dit au peuple : « N’ayez pas peur. Oui, vous avez fait tout ce mal ; mais ne cessez pas de suivre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Servez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} de tout votre cœur.
fr.R: Samuel a répondu au peuple : « N’ayez pas peur. C’est vrai, vous avez fait cette chose mauvaise. Mais ne cessez pas de suivre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Servez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} de tout votre cœur.

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên nói với dân chúng: "Đừng sợ. Chính anh em đã làm mọi điều ác này; chỉ đừng xây bỏ không theo {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nữa, nhưng hãy hết lòng phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Sa-mu-ên nói với dân chúng: "Đừng sợ. Đúng là anh em đã làm mọi điều ác này, nhưng đừng xây bỏ không theo {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Hãy hết lòng phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Sa-mu-ên đáp: "Đừng sợ. Đúng là anh em đã làm điều ác này. Nhưng đừng thôi đi theo {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Hãy hết lòng phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

decisions.choice: you, you have done: the pronoun stressed
decisions.reason: Samuel does not deny the people's guilt; the stated "you" admits it fully. The turn comes with "only": guilt is no reason to give up on Yahweh.

decisions.choice: turn aside from after Yahweh: stop following him
decisions.reason: To walk "after" Yahweh is to follow him; to turn aside from after him is to leave his way for other gods (Deuteronomy 11:16, 28).

decisions.choice: serve Yahweh with all your heart
decisions.reason: The words recall the commands of Deuteronomy to love and serve Yahweh with all the heart (Deuteronomy 10:12; 11:13). Samuel called for the same in 7:3.

decisions.choice: Samuel's speech opens here and closes at the end of verse 25
decisions.reason: Samuel's second speech runs to the end of the chapter, so the quotation opens here and closes in verse 25.

source.text: וְלֹ֖א תָּס֑וּרוּ כִּ֣י׀אַחֲרֵ֣י הַתֹּ֗הוּ אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־יוֹעִ֛ילוּ וְלֹ֥א יַצִּ֖ילוּ כִּי־תֹ֥הוּ הֵֽמָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And not you shall turn aside, for after the emptiness which not profit and not deliver, for emptiness they [are].

en.L: And do not turn aside, for [then you would go] after empty things which cannot profit and cannot deliver, for they are emptiness.
en.B: Do not turn aside to follow worthless things that cannot help you or rescue you, because they are worthless.
en.R: Do not turn away to follow idols. They are useless. They cannot help you or save you, because they are nothing at all.

es.L: Y no {{plural_you:se aparten|os apartéis}}, porque [irían] tras vanidades que no aprovechan ni libran, porque son vanidad.
es.B: No {{plural_you:se aparten|os apartéis}} para seguir cosas vanas que no pueden {{plural_you:ayudarlos|ayudaros}} ni {{plural_you:librarlos|libraros}}, porque son vanas.
es.R: No {{plural_you:se aparten|os apartéis}} para seguir a los ídolos. Son inútiles. No pueden {{plural_you:ayudarlos|ayudaros}} ni {{plural_you:salvarlos|salvaros}}, porque no son nada.

fr.L: Et ne vous détournez pas, car [vous iriez] après le néant, qui ne sert à rien et ne délivre pas, car c’est le néant.
fr.B: Ne vous détournez pas pour suivre des choses vaines, qui ne peuvent ni aider ni sauver, parce qu’elles ne sont que néant.
fr.R: Ne vous détournez pas pour suivre des idoles. Elles sont inutiles. Elles ne peuvent ni vous aider ni vous sauver, parce qu’elles ne sont rien du tout.

vi.L: Đừng xây bỏ, vì [như vậy anh em sẽ đi] theo những thứ hư không chẳng ích lợi gì và chẳng giải cứu được, vì chúng là hư không.
vi.B: Đừng xây bỏ để đi theo những thứ hư không, là những thứ không giúp gì được và không giải cứu được anh em, vì chúng là hư không.
vi.R: Đừng bỏ đi theo các thần tượng. Chúng vô dụng. Chúng không thể giúp đỡ hay giải cứu anh em, vì chúng chẳng là gì cả.

decisions.choice: emptiness: false gods
decisions.reason: The word means something formless and empty, a waste (Genesis 1:2; Isaiah 45:18). Here it names the idols Israel might follow: they are nothing, and they can do nothing (Isaiah 41:29; 44:9).

decisions.choice: for after emptiness: a short way of saying where turning aside would lead
alternatives: do not turn aside after empty things (Greek)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is clipped: "do not turn aside, for after emptiness". The sense is that turning away from Yahweh means going after empty gods. The Greek translation leaves out "for", reading "do not turn aside after the empty things". The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: cannot profit and cannot deliver
decisions.reason: Samuel sets the idols against Yahweh, who delivered Israel again and again (verses 10-11). The people asked for deliverance; only Yahweh can give it.

decisions.choice: [then you would go]
decisions.reason: Literal supplies the words needed to make the clipped Hebrew read in English.

decisions.choice: idols ... nothing at all
decisions.reason: Readable names what the empty things are and gives the sense of "emptiness".

source.text: כִּ֠י לֹֽא־יִטֹּ֤שׁ יְהוָה֙ אֶת־עַמּ֔וֹ בַּעֲב֖וּר שְׁמ֣וֹ הַגָּד֑וֹל כִּ֚י הוֹאִ֣יל יְהוָ֔ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת אֶתְכֶ֛ם ל֖וֹ לְעָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For not will abandon YHWH his people for the sake of his name the great, for has been pleased YHWH to make you for himself a people.

en.L: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will not abandon {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, for the sake of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} great name, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has been pleased to make you a people for {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} great name's sake {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will not forsake {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has been pleased to make you {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own people.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will not leave {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people. He will keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} great name honored. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} was glad to make you {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own people.

es.L: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no abandonará a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, por causa de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gran nombre, porque {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} le ha placido {{plural_you:hacerlos|haceros}} pueblo para {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}}.
es.B: Por amor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gran nombre, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no desamparará a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, porque {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} le ha placido hacer de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio pueblo.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no dejará a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo. Mantendrá la honra de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gran nombre. {{divine_name:Al SEÑOR|A Yahvé}} le alegró hacer de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio pueblo.

fr.L: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’abandonnera pas {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, à cause de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} grand nom, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a voulu faire de vous {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Car, à cause de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} grand nom, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’abandonnera pas {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, puisqu’il a plu {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} de faire de vous {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} propre peuple.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’abandonnera pas {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. Il veut que {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} grand nom soit respecté. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a été heureux de faire de vous {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ không từ bỏ dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì cớ danh lớn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã vui lòng làm cho anh em thành một dân thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vì cớ danh lớn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ không lìa bỏ dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã vui lòng làm cho anh em thành dân riêng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ không bỏ dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài sẽ giữ cho danh lớn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được tôn trọng. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã vui lòng làm cho anh em thành dân riêng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: for the sake of his great name: Yahweh's own honor is at stake
decisions.reason: Yahweh's name is his known character and reputation among the nations. If he abandoned his people, it would be said that he could not keep them (Joshua 7:9; Numbers 14:15-16). His faithfulness does not rest on Israel's goodness.

decisions.choice: has been pleased: chose freely and willingly
decisions.reason: The verb means to decide or to be willing to do something. Yahweh chose Israel by his own free will, as Deuteronomy 7:7-8 says.

decisions.choice: to make you a people for himself
decisions.reason: This takes up the covenant promise, "I will take you as my people" (Exodus 6:7; Deuteronomy 29:12).

decisions.choice: He will keep his great name honored
decisions.reason: Readable explains what acting "for the sake of his name" means: protecting his honor and reputation.

source.text: גַּ֣ם אָנֹכִ֗י חָלִ֤ילָה לִּי֙ מֵחֲטֹ֣א לַֽיהוָ֔ה מֵחֲדֹ֖ל לְהִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל בַּעַדְכֶ֑ם וְהוֹרֵיתִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ הַטּוֹבָ֖ה וְהַיְשָׁרָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Also I, far be it to me from sinning against YHWH from ceasing to pray for you; and I will teach you in [the] way, the good and the upright.

en.L: As for me also, far be it from me to sin against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} by ceasing to pray for you; and I will teach you the good and upright way.
en.B: As for me, far be it from me to sin against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} by ceasing to pray for you. I will go on teaching you the way that is good and right.
en.R: As for me, I will never sin against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} by stopping my prayers for you. I will keep on teaching you to live in a way that is good and right.

es.L: En cuanto a mí también, lejos esté de mí pecar contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dejando de orar por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}; y {{plural_you:les|os}} enseñaré el camino bueno y recto.
es.B: En cuanto a mí, lejos esté de mí pecar contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dejando de orar por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Seguiré {{plural_you:enseñándoles|enseñándoos}} el camino bueno y recto.
es.R: En cuanto a mí, nunca pecaré contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dejando de orar por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Seguiré {{plural_you:enseñándoles|enseñándoos}} a vivir de una manera buena y recta.

fr.L: Moi aussi, loin de moi de pécher contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} en cessant de prier pour vous ; et je vous enseignerai le bon et droit chemin.
fr.B: Quant à moi, loin de moi l’idée de pécher contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} en cessant de prier pour vous ! Je continuerai à vous enseigner le chemin qui est bon et droit.
fr.R: Quant à moi, jamais je ne pécherai contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} en arrêtant de prier pour vous. Je continuerai à vous apprendre à vivre d’une manière bonne et juste.

vi.L: Còn tôi, tôi quyết không phạm tội với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bằng cách thôi cầu nguyện cho anh em; tôi sẽ dạy anh em con đường tốt lành và ngay thẳng.
vi.B: Còn tôi, tôi quyết không phạm tội với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà thôi cầu nguyện cho anh em. Tôi sẽ tiếp tục dạy anh em con đường tốt lành và ngay thẳng.
vi.R: Còn tôi, tôi sẽ không bao giờ phạm tội với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bằng cách ngừng cầu nguyện cho anh em. Tôi sẽ tiếp tục dạy anh em sống theo cách tốt lành và ngay thẳng.

decisions.choice: far be it from me: a strong refusal
decisions.reason: The expression is an oath-like refusal: "May it never be that I do this!" (Genesis 18:25; Joshua 24:16).

decisions.choice: to stop praying for the people would be a sin against Yahweh
decisions.reason: Samuel treats prayer for the people as part of the task Yahweh gave him. Though he is no longer their leader in battle and law, he remains their prophet who prays and teaches (7:5, 8-9).

decisions.choice: teach you the way: instruct you how to live
decisions.reason: The way is a path of life. The verb for "teach" is related to the word for instruction or law; Samuel will go on showing the people how Yahweh wants them to live.

decisions.choice: go on teaching (Balanced); keep on teaching (Readable)
decisions.reason: Samuel has always taught the people; Balanced and Readable show that this goes on, set beside his ceasing to pray, which he refuses.

source.text: אַ֣ךְ׀יְר֣אוּ אֶת־יְהוָ֗ה וַעֲבַדְתֶּ֥ם אֹת֛וֹ בֶּאֱמֶ֖ת בְּכָל־לְבַבְכֶ֑ם כִּ֣י רְא֔וּ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־הִגְדִּ֖ל עִמָּכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Only fear YHWH and serve him in truth with all your heart; for see what he has done great with you.

en.L: Only fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in truth with all your heart; for see what great things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done for you.
en.B: Only fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} faithfully with all your heart. Think of the great things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done for you.
en.R: Just respect {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and worship {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} faithfully with your whole heart. Remember the great things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done for you.

es.L: Solamente {{plural_you:teman|temed}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y {{plural_you:sírvanle|servidle}} en verdad con todo {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}}; porque {{plural_you:miren|mirad}} cuán grandes cosas ha hecho por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Solo {{plural_you:teman|temed}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y {{plural_you:sírvanle|servidle}} fielmente con todo {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}}. {{plural_you:Piensen|Pensad}} en las grandes cosas que ha hecho por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Solo {{plural_you:respeten|respetad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y {{plural_you:adórenle|adoradle}} fielmente con todo {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}}. {{plural_you:Recuerden|Recordad}} las grandes cosas que ha hecho por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

fr.L: Seulement, craignez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et servez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} en vérité de tout votre cœur ; car voyez quelles grandes choses {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a faites pour vous.
fr.B: Seulement, craignez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et servez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} fidèlement de tout votre cœur. Pensez aux grandes choses qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a faites pour vous.
fr.R: Respectez seulement {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et adorez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} fidèlement de tout votre cœur. Souvenez-vous des grandes choses qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a faites pour vous.

vi.L: Chỉ hãy kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và hết lòng phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cách chân thật; vì hãy xem những việc lớn lao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho anh em.
vi.B: Chỉ hãy kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và hết lòng trung tín phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Hãy nghĩ đến những việc lớn lao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho anh em.
vi.R: Chỉ cần tôn kính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và hết lòng trung tín thờ phượng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Hãy nhớ những việc lớn lao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho anh em.

decisions.choice: in truth: faithfully, with loyalty
decisions.reason: The word means firmness and faithfulness, and so truth. To serve "in truth" is to serve with steady loyalty, not with a show of worship (Joshua 24:14).

decisions.choice: for see what great things he has done: the reason to serve
alternatives: see the great thing he has done (the storm)
decisions.reason: The "for" gives the reason for the command: Yahweh's great acts, including the sign just given (verse 18) and the history of verses 8-11, call for faithful service.

decisions.choice: faithfully; Think of (Balanced); Remember (Readable)
decisions.reason: "See" here means to consider. Balanced and Readable give that sense, and "faithfully" for "in truth".

source.text: וְאִם־הָרֵ֖עַ תָּרֵ֑עוּ גַּם־אַתֶּ֥ם גַּֽם־מַלְכְּכֶ֖ם תִּסָּפֽוּ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And if doing evil you do evil, both you and your king will be swept away.

en.L: But if you indeed do evil, both you and your king will be swept away."
en.B: But if you go on doing evil, you and your king alike will be swept away."
en.R: But if you keep on doing evil, both you and your king will be destroyed."

es.L: Pero si de cierto {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} el mal, tanto {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} como {{plural_you:su rey|vuestro rey}} serán barridos».
es.B: Pero si {{plural_you:siguen|seguís}} haciendo el mal, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y {{plural_you:su rey|vuestro rey}} serán barridos por igual».
es.R: Pero si {{plural_you:siguen|seguís}} haciendo el mal, tanto {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} como {{plural_you:su rey|vuestro rey}} serán destruidos».

fr.L: Mais si vous faites vraiment le mal, vous et votre roi, vous serez emportés. »
fr.B: Mais si vous persistez à faire le mal, vous et votre roi, vous serez emportés. »
fr.R: Mais si vous continuez à faire le mal, vous et votre roi, vous serez détruits. »

vi.L: Nhưng nếu anh em cứ làm điều ác, thì cả anh em lẫn vua anh em đều sẽ bị quét sạch."
vi.B: Nhưng nếu anh em cứ làm điều ác, thì cả anh em lẫn vua anh em đều sẽ bị quét sạch."
vi.R: Nhưng nếu anh em cứ tiếp tục làm điều ác, thì cả anh em lẫn vua anh em đều sẽ bị tiêu diệt."

decisions.choice: doing evil you do evil: going on in evil
alternatives: if you do evil at all
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled for emphasis. It describes a settled course of evil, not a single wrong.

decisions.choice: swept away: destroyed, as by a sudden end
decisions.reason: The verb is used of being carried off and destroyed (Genesis 19:15, 17). The warning comes true for Saul (31:1-6), and in the end for the kingdom when it is taken into exile.

decisions.choice: indeed do evil (Literal); go on doing evil (Balanced); keep on doing evil (Readable)
decisions.reason: Each level gives the force of the doubled verb in its own way. The quotation that opened in verse 20 closes here.
